INITIAL_EXPLORATION.name: INITIAL_EXPLORATION

OBJECT_RELEVANCE_SCREENING.name: OBJECT_RELEVANCE_SCREENING
OBJECT_RELEVANCE_SCREENING.objective: Test small subsets of objects to find which ones participate in activations.
guidelines: Test subsets of 2–3 objects at a time. Place them on the detector in varied orders and observe whether the detector activates.
Track a scorecard: for each object, count how many times it appeared in a subset that activated vs. subsets that did not activate.
Try at least 3 different subsets before moving on. Vary which objects you include and the order you place them.
If you observe any activation, note exactly which objects were present and in what order they were placed. This is critical information.
If after testing several subsets you have zero activations, note which objects appeared most frequently in your tests — you may need to try different orders or combinations in the next phase.
Do NOT place all objects at once. Keep subsets small (2–3) so you can identify which objects are contributing to activations.

transitions.condition: After observing at least 1 activation, or after testing 3+ subsets with zero activations
If results are confusing, go back to individual tests

guidelines: Test different groupings of objects on the detector
